cause: The ManiOS console uses a cooked line discipline. QEMU monitor sendkey delivered Z without Enter (so the line was not completed), and F2/Alt+X have no ASCII representation in the console input path. This confirms the existing EDITV Partial result; it is not evidence that EDITV save itself is broken.
note: Earlier serial input of Z followed by Enter did insert text; function-key scan codes remain undeliverable.
